restrictions: Decorative regions only; interactive controls and text must be real UI.
Incomplete fragments must not be presented as complete backgrounds or tiled/stretched to claim 1:1 fidelity.
Source crops preserve opaque raster backing. No transparency has been invented and no missing pixels reconstructed.
Portrait is reference-fixture-only. Production photos continue to come from identity APIs.
Native-size fidelity only. Larger or theme-adapted compositions need original clean exports or documented adaptations.
